rooms.1: A gloomy castle chapel: heavy white curtains drawn back on both sides, a pale blue wall, two tall iron candelabras with lit candles, and in the centre an empty draped stone bier on red-carpeted steps.
rooms.2: A dingy stairwell in a castle: a long narrow flight of worn reddish stone stairs climbing steeply straight ahead into a dark opening at the top, cracked pale plaster walls closing in on both sides, dim cold light.
rooms.3: A room in a castle: a long stone room of pale grey blocks in strong perspective, a terracotta flagstone floor, bare, cold and silent.
rooms.4: A rough tunnel: craggy orange rock walls and fallen boulders around a massive arched stone door at the far end with a glittering blue sapphire set into its centre.
rooms.5: A room in a castle: walls of warm sandstone blocks hung with mounted hunting trophies, a moose head on the left wall and a snarling lion head in a gilt frame on the far wall, a blue-grey stone floor.
rooms.6: Medium Maegen's mad room: green velvet curtains parted on a vivid magenta wall, a round table draped in deep purple cloth embroidered with a crescent moon and a star, a glowing crystal ball on top, candlelight.
rooms.7: A room in a castle: a long hall with sandstone block walls and dark wooden ceiling beams in perspective, a worn plank floor.
rooms.8: A room in a castle: a bare peach-plastered room seen into a corner, a small dark boarded-up hatch high on the far wall, a hairline crack running down the right wall, a round dark hole low in the left wall.
rooms.9: A room in a castle: rough orange flagstone walls framing a large closed window with four panes looking out at blue sky and clouds.
rooms.10: A ballroom: a grand room with pale green striped silk walls and a green marble floor, a huge brick fireplace with a tall chimney breast in the centre of the far wall, its hearth dark, chandelier light.
rooms.11: A dungeon: rough orange stone walls, an iron ring with a manacle on the left wall, a heavy wooden door with a small barred window standing ajar on the right, straw on the floor.
rooms.12: The armory: a vaulted stone room with arched ribs, shields and crossed weapons hung high on the walls, a knight's suit of armour holding a halberd standing on the left, a cobbled floor.
rooms.13: A torture chamber: a bare stone room, a heavy beam with chains across the ceiling, a small arched mousehole-sized door at the base of the far wall, a rack and shackles in the gloom.
rooms.14: Inside a chimney looking up: a square shaft of red brick in steep perspective rising to a dark opening far above, a few broken wooden boards nailed across the walls below.
rooms.15: Inside a large fireplace looking up: white stone walls of the firebox, soot-blackened, a dark iron flue plate closed overhead with a lever, a stone floor.
rooms.16: A room in a castle: curved orange stone walls like the inside of a tower, a round dark porthole window high up, a stone floor, light slanting in.
rooms.17: A mad scientist's lab: wooden benches crowded with bubbling flasks, test tubes, chemical bottles and a big steaming cauldron, cobwebs in the arched ceiling corners.
rooms.18: Inside a narrow part of a chimney looking up: a tight square shaft of red brick rising to a small patch of blue sky at the top.
rooms.19: A graveyard at night: a gnarled tree root sprawling across the ground, a weathered headstone with a cross on it (no lettering), an open crypt doorway, broken earth and grass.
rooms.20: A Victorian parlor: striped wallpaper, two small windows, a plush button-tufted rust-orange sofa against the far wall, a polished wooden floor, lamp light.
rooms.21: A jail cell: rough rock walls, an iron-barred cell door in the centre, a lantern hanging on a hook by the door, a dirt floor.
rooms.22: A ledge high on a castle wall: looking out from a narrow white stone ledge past green ivy at a distant castle tower on a hill against blue sky.
rooms.23: A hidden voodoo room: rough orange rock, a draped altar covered in a glowing purple voodoo cloth, a grinning human skull resting on it, eerie light.
rooms.24: A room in a castle: an empty room with peach plastered walls seen into a corner, bare floorboards, dust in a slanting beam of light.
rooms.25: Doom: a grinning red-faced devil with horns and wild eyes reaching out with a clawed white-gloved hand against a magenta background.

items.6: A dark round hole broken through a plaster wall, ragged edges, blackness inside.
items.10: An open window with its four-paned casement swung wide, blue sky with clouds beyond, in a stone frame.
items.13: An open iron flue plate in a fireplace chimney, swung open, showing a dark sooty shaft beyond.
items.17: A closed black wooden coffin with brass handles, lying on its side as seen from the front.
items.23: A spirit medium seen from the waist up only, as if seated behind a table that is not shown: an old fortune-teller woman in a red headscarf and fringed shawl, hands raised and fingers spread over an unseen crystal ball, eyes half closed in a trance. The figure is cut off cleanly at the waist along the bottom edge.
items.28: A slick metal chute sloping steeply downward into darkness, opening in a wall.
items.31: A wide jagged crack split open in a plaster wall, dark inside.
items.34: An open iron wall safe with its heavy door swung open, empty inside.
items.35: A chimney sweep stuck in a chimney: a soot-covered man in a top hat wedged with his arms up, brush in hand, looking down helplessly.
items.37: A closed iron wall safe with a combination dial.
items.41: A wide open wooden door in a stone doorframe, light beyond.
items.48: An iron grating of heavy crossed bars, set flat in a stone frame.
items.50: A round brass button set in a stone wall.
items.65: Count Cristo: a pale, smiling vampire count in a black cape with a high collar, sitting upright, grinning with fangs.
